english.title: Fail to allow examination or inspection of gauge or weir measuring water flow or records or take copies
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to allow **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED PERSON..), a person authorised for the purpose

(A)_[by or under a drought order made on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER MADE..) under section 73]_
(B)_[by virtue of a drought permit issued on **(..SPECIFY DATE PERMIT ISSUED..) under section 79A]_

of the Water Resources Act 1991, to

(C)_[inspect and examine a gauge]_
(D)_[inspect and examine a weir]_
(E)_[inspect and examine apparatus for measuring the flow of water, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..)]_
(F)_[inspect and examine records made in respect of a gauge, weir or apparatus for measuring the flow of water or kept by you in connection therewith]_
(G)_[take copies of records made in respect of a gauge, weir or apparatus for measuring the flow of water or kept by you in connection therewith]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80(2)(b) and (4) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
failed to allow a person authorised for the purpose
by or under a drought order or by virtue of a drought permit
to inspect and examine a gauge, weir or other apparatus for measuring the flow of water
or records made thereby or kept by you in connection therewith
or to take copies of such records

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: In proceedings against any person for an offence under this section it shall be a defence to show that he took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of the offence - section 80(4)

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
